title: Application recovery verified; hosted SEO staging prepared
summary: Classified all 36 full-restore failures. A filtered local application restore completed without errors and all 110 COPY table contents matched. Synthetic staging and local authorization checks passed; production migration remains NO-GO pending hosted integration.

changes.detail: Added a reproducible local-only application recovery profile with explicit managed-object exclusions, atomic restore and exact COPY content verification.
Added a synthetic five-table staging baseline and Free Plan setup/acceptance guide; no production data or credentials included.
Documented each restore failure and identified the cron/Vault/pg_net dependency of scheduled micro-learning.
Added a start-only mode for the existing isolated cluster without reinitializing it.

validation.name: Original backup and recovery
validation.detail: Original SHA-256 unchanged. Filtered restore exit 0; 38 managed archive entries excluded. All 110 COPY tables, including 61 public tables, matched row counts, column lists and sorted row-content SHA-256 hashes using UTC.

validation.name: Non-superuser SEO compatibility
validation.detail: Reviewed migration passed under NOSUPERUSER with ownership privileges and broad defaults; all 34 postflight checks passed.

validation.name: Product and SEO behavior
validation.detail: New product creation/update, real deterministic SEO generation and service-role draft/approve passed locally; behavioral writes rolled back.

validation.name: Synthetic staging and authorization
validation.detail: Five-table baseline executed locally and produced two SEO documents. Ten real session/permission checks passed using synthetic staff tables and a SQL transport adapter.

validation.name: Hosted staging integration
validation.detail: User confirmed no Supabase staging project exists. Actual REST, middleware, login, cache and hosted service tests remain pending; adapter checks are not HTTP tests.

validation.name: Managed automation recovery
validation.detail: Scheduled tick_micro_learning requires Vault and pg_net and is not operational locally. No production job, secret or callback was executed.

validation.name: Local cleanup
validation.detail: Isolated server stopped; protected data and logs retained outside Git.
